description: Independently authored toy guidance; no benchmark-derived content.

chunks.text: An undeclared RTL identifier is commonly caused by a signal rename or typographical error. Repair the local identifier and rerun RTL preparation.
A named-port mismatch should be repaired at the module instance or interface definition without bypassing the instance.
An SDC get_ports query that matches no object should be checked against the top-level RTL port names. Do not relax the reference clock period.
A missing VERILOG_FILES path should be corrected to an existing user-design source path; do not edit tool or PDK files.
Extremely high core utilization may make floorplan initialization infeasible. Restore a design-specific reference utilization.
Placement density near one may prevent legalization. Restore the validated design configuration rather than disabling checks.
A routing maximum layer that is too low can create unrouted nets. Restore the validated routing stack limit.
An accidental clock-period edit should be restored to the reference constraint. Increasing the reference period merely to hide a violation is prohibited.
